subject: Follow-up and demo scheduling: 30-minute intro + stakeholder alignment
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex@stratify.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 28, 2026 at 3:03 PM PDT
Subject: Follow-up and demo scheduling: 30-minute intro + stakeholder alignment

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today. Quick recap from my side:
- Primary use case: index + retrieval to surface policy docs to customer support agents (reduce MTTR on policy-related tickets).
- Load profile: intermittent bursts (10–50 qps) with 1–2k token context when agents pull conversation history.
- Success criteria you called out: <30ms 95th latency for short lookups, deterministic redaction, and audit logs for compliance.

Next step: book a short 30-minute product intro so we can walk your platform owners through the runtime, caching, and RBAC model. Can you confirm which stakeholders should attend (engineering lead, security, support ops)? If useful, we can tailor the agenda to include a quick SLA/retention overview.

I have three windows available next week in your timezone (PT):
1) Tue May 4 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
2) Tue May 4 — 2:30–3:00 PM PT
3) Wed May 5 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT

Please pick the one that works, or suggest two alternatives and I’ll lock it. I’ve attached a draft mutual action plan and our one-pager to help prep.

Proposed 30-min agenda (flexible):
- 5m quick recap & goals
- 10m product walkthrough (runtime, KV/prefix caching)
- 10m ops/security (SLA, logging, data residency options)
- 5m next steps / mutual action plan

If you want Ben to cover any deeper technical topics, I’ve CC’d him — he’s our solutions engineer and will join the demo if there’s interest in a technical deep dive.

Calendar link: https://calendar.redwoodinference.com/b/abc-30min-demo-slot

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: Stratify_mutual_action_plan_draft.pdf, redwood-product-one-pager.pdf
From: Alex Romero <alex@stratify.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Apr 29, 2026 at 9:12 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Follow-up and demo scheduling: 30-minute intro + stakeholder alignment

Hey Grace —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. All looks aligned with what we discussed. We should include our support ops manager and one of our platform engineers. Adding Priya Shah (support ops) on the thread so she can confirm availability.

Of the three windows, option 2 on Tue May 4, 2:30–3:00 PM PT works best for our team. Can we add a line to the agenda to cover:
- How source documents are indexed and how redaction integrates with our ingestion pipeline (~5–7m)
- Brief note on alerting/metrics we can surface to Datadog?

Also curious on sizing: if we start with a pilot (1k agents), what are your typical throughput assumptions and cost ballpark? If Ben can surface a quick pilot playbook in the demo that would be helpful.

Thanks —
Alex Romero
Head of Platform, Stratify
alex@stratify.com | +1 (206) 555-0199

Perfect — locking Tue May 4, 2:30–3:00 PM PT. I’ll send a calendar invite in a moment.

Updated agenda (30m):
- 3m quick intros & goals (Alex, Priya, Grace)
- 10m product walkthrough: indexing model choices, prefix/KV caching, runtime kernel selection (Ben)
- 8m ops/security: audit logs, retention controls, data residency (Mina)
- 4m pilot sizing & next steps (MAP + pilot playbook)
- 5m Q&A and action items

Ben — can you prepare 2 slides on indexing + redaction flow and a rough pilot-cost slide (ballpark numbers for 1k agents / expected qps)? Mina — can you prepare a short notes block on audit log retention and KMS integrations to surface during the ops section?

I attached a one-page agenda file and updated MAP draft. The calendar invite contains a Zoom link and a short pre-demo checklist for your team (who to invite, sample documents to bring, and what success looks like).

Invite: https://calendar.redwoodinference.com/b/abc-30min-demo-slot (invite sent)

Thanks all — looking forward to it.
